title: Prevent public dock intercepting real Portal V2 mobile Meer after hydration
root_cause: Real 390px production Playwright mobile More button could not receive click: public bg-app-public-dock-link intercepts pointer events; URL-only exclusion did not cover routed private portal shell.
impact: Mobile private menu inaccessible; independent Portal V2 Production DOM Readback failed after a successful Netlify release.
fix: One original app JS DOM-based private portal guard and public dock CSS fail-closed at late hydration; no second UX router, customer-data store or worker.
prevention_rule: Public website dock and original Portal V2 four-tab navigation are mutually exclusive, including rewritten URLs and async hydration. Real browser click proof, not visibility alone.
outcome: Candidate pending protected source, browser, exact current Netlify and independent production mobile DOM readback; customer/Powerhouse/Heartbeat outcome not claimed.
